Voice comparison

Six sentences, each spoken by Apple's system voices and by Qwen3-TTS (0.6B, 8-bit) on a Mac, 20 November 2026. The error columns come from transcribing each clip back with Rumble-2-Flash: they measure whether the words are recognisable, not whether the voice sounds pleasant. Listen to judge that.

  • Apple system voices. Standard-quality Samantha, Milena and Yuna. Mixed sentences are split where the writing system changes, one voice per piece — what the app does today.
  • Qwen3-TTS, one language. The whole sentence with its main language named.
  • Qwen3-TTS, language left to the model. The whole sentence, language set to auto.
  • Qwen3-TTS, split by writing system. Each piece generated separately with its own language, then joined.

One Qwen3 clip (Russian with English words, split) ran away into eleven minutes of noise; only its first 12 seconds are kept here.
